purpose: Reduce in-class answer lookup and repeated header-entry burden while preserving source, original-attempt, generated-paper and teacher-judgment lanes.

implemented.contract: Read one exact reviewed GetLectureList key, validate exactly one identity-qualified row, preserve literal official answer fields and distinguish the qualified external solution pointer from unrendered literal payloads; not a student response or qualified special rendering.
One to thirty-two unique literal keys in request order, observation callback before advancing, explicit pending suffix on first failure, no automatic retries; persistence failure propagates.
Validate answer scope/order/status/pending and exact source namespaces, separate stable answer content from acquisition time; no storage/write authority.

Index qualified retained textbook attempts once, match exact student/key/name and lecture/outer namespaces, preserve original paper/attempt/ordinal/OX/date and all evidence references. Physical generated clinic identity stays unknown.

For item_answer only: exact StudyCourse route and single reqCmd, both userForm pri_no and form1 g_pri_no equal the previously qualified admitted teacherKey, current academy origin/logout and no password form. Preserve native vault and all other family guards.

existingPublicEntry.execute: Use the prepared expression through the admitted native browser on the current qualified StudyCourse page; never export cookies or use an unsupervised HTTP client.
existingPublicEntry.recover: Read __academyItemAnswerRecovery for the current invocation after an uncertain tool timeout, persist observed answers privately, then explicitly admit only pending keys; do not replay successful reads.
existingPublicEntry.trace: Use tracePaperLineage with exact studentKey/studentName, orderedLabels and evidenceRef/acquisition pairs from retained textbook reads. Do not put student/answer snapshots in Git.

actualPrivateAcquisition.meaning: Task-bounded teacher-authenticated same-origin HTTP acquisition; not direct SQL, whole history, unattended authentication, a physical print receipt or production consumer activation.

validation.review: Lead self-review, not independent reviewer approval
regressionsFoundAndRepaired: Native same-origin non-StudyCourse shell failed the new route refusal test; add exact route/single-selector binding.
Checkpoint reference list initially exceeded the existing cap; retain only the receipt pointer without widening the checkpoint contract.
validation.gitAndRequiredCi: Separate actual publication readback; these local results do not certify CI or deployment.

peerIntegration.recipient: Other existing feature-branch session / product implementation owner
peerIntegration.delivery: Repository handoff plus user-carried file; peer acknowledgement is not verified and no cross-profile synchronization is installed.
consume: Fetch the published branch/main and read this receipt before touching overlapping protocol, native entry, endpoint catalog or package test lists.
Reconcile against the tested merge SHA; do not overwrite the existing dirty primary worktree or adopt its private raw evidence by implication.
Reuse the new literal-answer and lineage seams in the existing UI/Backend/WebMCP scope; do not create another paper registry or demand repeated headers.
Keep shared official answers out of arbitrary student partitions and retain source grading beside append-only teacher inspection.

openAcceptance: Source solution-file retrieval and exact item/version linkage for the pointer-only item; current shared row has no qualified file URL, and a separate catalog observation did not provide PDF controls.
Special answer renderer and printed answer-version qualification.
Actual generated clinic instance/version, complete ordered membership, print/distribution and possible reprints.
Frontend, protected Backend history and browser WebMCP consumer wiring; this unit does not deploy or activate them.
recovery: Retain original private teacher/source evidence and partial observations. Revert only this scoped code unit if needed; preserve foreign work, native learning and source locks. A blocked solution/paper contract must not erase acquired answers or certify an invented join.
